$comment: How each Oracle JET element in the bank’s code maps to the premium JET pack (bx- elements). Generated by gen-jet-mapping.js; the premium elements keep the JET attribute and event names, so what is listed under properties with the same from and to works unchanged. Confidence is high where the parity test (gates/specs/parity.spec.ts) passed, medium where the API was compared by hand.
